amendment: V5 failed its prospective direct-chip RSS coverage gate. That qualitative failure motivates this independent V6 study; no V5 held-out residual, point estimate, or gate observation is used as a V6 fit or calibration input. V5 training-only leave-one-program-out residuals motivate scaling the chip interval with predicted RSS. All interval coefficients are re-estimated solely from fresh V6 training programs before V6 validation.
artifact_retention_policy: Fail before native build/proof phase if host volume has under 8 GiB available. Retain V4/V5 raw cohorts and all V6 package/proof evidence; no opportunistic deletion during a frozen corpus.
chip_manifest_policy: every direct-chip package must carry s31-component-manifest-direct-chip-v2 with exactly one chip_call at call_id 0, bound in sealed native key and package manifest
external_anchor_policy: Before first V6 native build, commit design/s31/measurements/language/whole-prover-cost-v6-protocol-freeze.json containing schema, aware UTC timestamp, full protocol SHA, source/engine/compiler/tool pins; externally record its full commit SHA and protocol SHA in a timestamped message. Pass both to every build/prove phase. After fresh V6 training and before any V6 held-out build, similarly commit whole-prover-cost-v6-model-freeze.json with full model SHA, V6 training corpus SHA, protocol SHA and timestamp; externally record full commit SHA and model SHA. Runner requires committed anchor bytes at ancestor commits, exact current bytes, and model anchor descendant of protocol anchor. Draft files or CLI arguments alone are insufficient chronological evidence.

features.chip_fri_domain_rows: for direct-chip only, maximum 2^trace_log_size over generated typed-manifest components; captures the largest FRI tier
features.chip_trace_cells: for direct-chip only, sum over generated typed-manifest components of (2^trace_log_size) * (base_trace_columns + interaction_trace_columns); captures total committed AIR trace work
features.hash_work: 1 + raw blake_g rows; used for opaque gate hash prove stage

host_policy: one named host and one compiler fingerprint for every train/validation package; no cross-host reliability claim
model: V5 whole-wall and proof-byte point/interval formulas unchanged. RSS point fit remains positive affine for arithmetic/direct chip and log-linear for hash/fixed width. Non-chip RSS keeps the V5 symmetric absolute-byte radius. Direct-chip RSS uses a symmetric radius equal to max(training-only leave-one-program-out absolute-byte residual envelope, training-only relative residual envelope times predicted RSS center). No V5 or V6 held-out residual enters fit or calibration.
point_target: per-program arithmetic mean of 100 fresh-process prover-plus-native-verifier wall times; a sampling estimate of expected wall under the pinned host/process policy, distinct from v3.1 program median
pow_variance: Keep interaction and FRI PoW separate where timers expose them; hash prove includes opaque PoW. Report stage means, medians, p90, CV, and process-wall variance. Never interpret fixed 26-bit PoW as deterministic. Use 100 independent transcript-dependent assignments/program.
prebuild_admission_amendment: V6 keeps i128 quotient-only training and remainder-only held-out circuits because the current public ABI allows eight u16 output words, while publishing quotient and remainder together would require sixteen. This is declared before any V6 native observation.
rss_interval: For each fresh V6 training program j, fit its family RSS point model on all other V6 training programs. For its 100 trials compute signed residuals r_ij=observed RSS bytes minus the out-of-fold predicted center p_j. Let a_j=max(abs(q05(r_ij)),abs(q95(r_ij))). For non-chip families use radius=max_j a_j. For direct chip also set rho=max_j(a_j/p_j) and for a future predicted center p use radius=max(max_j a_j,rho*p). Interval is [max(0,p-radius),p+radius]. All p_j must be positive. Calibration and fitting use V6 training only; no V5 or V6 held-out values alter the radius.
selection_policy: Automatic lowering stays disabled even after a local pass; independent source revision, host transfer, cached setup, paired lowering comparisons, and proof soundness equivalence remain separate prerequisites
source_pin_policy: Before the first native V6 build, replace null source/engine/compiler digests with exact integrated commits and compiler SHA-256, freeze protocol SHA, and reject any compiler change across all builds/trials.
split_policy: All V6 train and held-out source bytes and assignment values are newly generated, disjoint within V6 and checked against V4/V5 generated sources and assignments at static admission. Fit only fresh V6 train; commit and externally record exact serialized model SHA before any V6 held-out package build. Reject duplicate source/assignment digests and require exact host/compiler/tool/protocol/profile/FRI match. Separate build/prove phases; prove checks committed anchors and build-inventory protocol and model SHA.
tool_pin_policy: Before first V6 native build, pin a sorted explicit inventory of all S31 benchmark and frontend Python paths plus aggregate SHA-256. Runner/publisher require exact path inventory and bytes. Later added files require replay on pinned checkout.
wall_interval: For each training program, fit the full stage model on all other training programs, predict its expected wall, and collect every observed trial-wall / out-of-fold prediction ratio. Use pooled 5th and 95th percentile ratios as the prospective per-trial interval around the full-training expected-wall prediction. This interval is empirical and has no guaranteed tail coverage.
